import json
cmds=[]
for line in open('counterparty-c2a-gate3-r26.jsonl'):
    try: o=json.loads(line)
    except: continue
    m=o.get('message') or {}
    c=m.get('content') if isinstance(m,dict) else None
    if not isinstance(c,list): continue
    for x in c:
        if isinstance(x,dict) and x.get('type')=='tool_use': cmds.append(x['input'].get('command') or '')
print(cmds[39]); print('====38'); print(cmds[38])
